notes: eng_for_ben is clean and dominated by false positives: 90 fp_subgloss (one canonical LEGO plus many contextual component slices of pronouns, particles like না/করা, and verb roots glossed inside larger phrases) and 51 fp_inflection (English target morphology — to-speak/speak, learnt/I've learnt, friend/friends, watch/watched — Bengali agglutinative endings and the analytic English target produce these naturally). The 50 genuine fixes are NOT core-token overloads but two structural patterns: (1) Bengali's genderless 3rd person (তাকে=him/her, সে=he/she) and number-neutral nouns (বন্ধু) systematically producing two English answers per identical prompt, clustered on the 176/177 him-her and 51/52 friend-friends paired seeds, and (2) sentence-level build-vs-use paraphrase drift at a single seed (article, contraction, word-order, want/I'd-like, watch/see). All are count-1 or systematic-but-low-frequency, so no release blockers.
